title: AMC 8 Practice: Counting Sets of Socks With a Pair — Count the Rest
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on counting with complements, finding sets of 4 socks from 5 pairs that include a matching pair. (Level 4 of 5)
Zoe pulls 4 socks from a drawer of 5 pairs. How many sets of 4 contain a matching pair? Vantee shows why it is easier to count the sets with NO pair and subtract, then double-checks by counting the pair sets head-on. You will also see why 140 is a tempting trap, and get a six-pair drawer to try yourself.
